ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Child Care System
ideas.description: An investigation into the financial transactions and funding of Minnesota's child care system to identify potential areas of fraud and abuse.
questions: What are the main sources of funding for Minnesota's child care system?
How are funds allocated and distributed to child care providers?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and funding of the child care system, we may be able to identify potential areas of fraud and abuse and track the flow of money to determine where it is being misused.
